title: Hemispherical shell with an 18° hole under alternating point loads
source: MacNeal and Harder, 'A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy', Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1 (1985) 3–20, Fig. 9 (p. 9), Table 5(b) (p. 11): 0.0940 (lower bound 0.0924 from their [7])
requires: a doubly curved shell mesh: mesh.block's 2D form is planar and takes z = 0, so the quarter hemisphere with its 18° polar hole must be written node by node (as scordelis-lo-roof-shell and pinched-cylinder are), or a new patch command must mesh a doubly curved face

quantities.quantity: displacement under the load along the load
